description: Register a sourced monitor and get back the registered template. Each match is delivered to you as a cited result: the source URL, the paragraph text and a verification status. Inputs: id, connector_ids (your registered connectors to watch), query, optional jurisdiction and language filters, when to push (every_match, new_since_last, or delta_at_least with a count) and where to push (a webhook URL with an optional secret reference, or sse for an open MCP session).
